subject: too many white blank in donuts plot

messages.author: d4a4dda8f70cf3e6
messages.subject: too many white blank in donuts plot
parts:
Hi, everyone. I'd tried my best to adjust my plots, but there is no idea to solve my problem.

My plots are list below

Here is my codes

# 
plot_tbl <- data.frame(transcript_id = c("x", "x", "x"), color = 1:3, fraction = c(0.15, 0.7, 0.15))
ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = transcript_id, y = fraction, 
                       fill= color, color = color)) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c(" ", as.character(plot_tbl$transcript_id))) +
    geom_col(position = position_stack(1), width = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_polar("y", direction = -1, start = 0)
#
plot_tbl <- plot_tbl[1:2, ]
ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = transcript_id, y = fraction, 
                       fill= color, color = color)) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c(" ", as.character(plot_tbl$transcript_id))) +
    geom_col(position = position_stack(1), width = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_polar("y", direction = -1, start = 0)

messages.author: d4a4dda8f70cf3e6
messages.subject: Re: too many white blank in donuts plot
parts:
My fault.  I was too careless and forgot to use `unique`  groups.
So,  the right way should be 

scale_x_discrete(limits = c(" ", unique(as.character(plot_tbl$transcript_id))))
